svg.title: Buy the Evidence Before Buying the Parcel
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-evidence-to-title-insured-exit; chart type: process_flow; title: Buy the Evidence Before Buying the Parcel; subtitle: Five operating stages for vacant land, infill, and minor subdivisions; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The operator trades owned inventory as principal. Annual revenue means gross parcel sale proceeds, with acquisition costs included in the net-margin calculation. Desktop GIS results are screening evidence, not proof of access, boundaries, or development rights.; caption: Keep one parcel evidence packet from initial screening through recorded acquisition and insured disposition; unresolved fatal defects stop the purchase before capital becomes trapped.; stages: label: Screen the parcel; value: GIS and comparable sales; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Join county assessor records to QGIS parcel layers, FEMA flood mapping, terrain, and recorded comparable sales. Flag landlocked geometry, steep slopes, suspect lot lines, and asking prices unsupported by completed transactions.; label: Verify the rights; value: Access, title, and use; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Obtain the title commitment and exception documents; verify deeded access, easement scope, legal-lot status, zoning, utility availability, and environmental history. A visible road or neighboring house proves neither legal access nor permission to build.; label: Price and contract; value: Exit value less every cost; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Set the acquisition ceiling from defensible resale value less acquisition expense, diligence, selling expense, carry, and target profit. Preserve inspection rights and tie deposits to explicit termination dates.; label: Close and prepare; value: Insured acquisition and evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use a title or escrow provider to resolve closing requirements and record the deed. Complete only scoped survey, access, cleanup, or subdivision work supported by permits, written estimates, and the resale thesis.; label: Sell and reconcile; value: Recorded exit and released cash; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Publish substantiated parcel facts through suitable land channels or a licensed broker, close with title insurance, and reconcile settlement proceeds against parcel costs. Track days held, realized margin, and cash released.

circle.title: label: Screen the parcel; value: GIS and comparable sales; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Join county assessor records to QGIS parcel layers, FEMA flood mapping, terrain, and recorded comparable sales. Flag landlocked geometry, steep slopes, suspect lot lines, and asking prices unsupported by completed transactions.

A visible road or neighboring house proves neither legal access nor permission to build.

text.title: Publish substantiated parcel facts through suitable land channels or a licensed broker, close with title insurance, and reconcile settlement proceeds against parcel costs. Track days held, realized margin, and cash released.

Assumptions: The operator trades owned inventory as principal. Annual revenue means gross parcel sale proceeds, with acquisition costs included in the net-margin calculation. Desktop GIS results are screening evidence, not proof of access, boundaries, or development rights.
